However, .com may still offer indirect benefits: it is the most trusted and recognized extension among consumers, which can improve click-through rates and on-page engagement — both of which are direct ranking factors [d4][d5]. In summary, your overall SEO strategy matters far more than your choice of domain extension [d2].
